releaseEvidence: This checkpoint describes source changes, not deployment. Confirm the merged source tree, migration history and both production deploy-info responses before treating the batch as live.
scopedRepairs: Taiwan remark saves use browser-reviewed baselines, atomically validate all requested rows and require exact committed content and row-audit acknowledgements. Conflicts retain the draft; identical committed retries are read-only.

General Taiwan remarks remain unpublished after Save. Instructions point to Taiwan Price History and its separate Publish action, as chosen by the user. Special Notice and typhoon overlays keep their existing Save-and-refresh behavior.
Enquiry Worksheet send acknowledgements and report-close timers belong to the request and dialog that created them, not a later edited draft or reopened dialog.
SPC lost-record reviews compare the revision captured when the draft opened, acknowledge exact committed metadata and keep drafts on conflicts.

SPC presentation deletion requires the captured revision and cleans up only media returned by the successful deletion. Media completion retries preserve their original intent, validate the exact acknowledgement and retain unsaved text.
Valid supplier audit receipts are visible in the intended SPC Audit Log scope. Whole-store Undo remains unavailable so it cannot overwrite unrelated supplier edits.

Tech Stack validates the response before rendering, offers retry after failure, labels retained data and ignores cancelled responses from an older authenticated session. Backup-alert and cron descriptions match current source behavior.
